offering_description.value: Veeco designs and manufactures wafer processing equipment for semiconductor makers, photonics and data storage manufacturers, and research labs. Its systems deposit and etch thin films, anneal wafers, and perform lithography and wet processing for advanced packaging. It also sells replacement parts and provides field service and equipment upgrades.

primary_products.value: Laser annealing systems; chemical vapor deposition systems; ion beam deposition and etching systems; molecular beam epitaxy systems; lithography and wet processing systems

primary_services.value: Equipment installation; preventive maintenance; field repair; equipment upgrades

customer_segment.value: B2B: Chipmakers, semiconductor foundries, advanced packaging firms, photonics and data storage manufacturers, and private research institutions; B2G: Government materials and semiconductor research laboratories

end_markets.value: Semiconductors and advanced packaging; power electronics; photonics and optoelectronics; data storage; materials research

revenue_model.value: product sales: Wafer processing systems and replacement parts; service fees: Equipment maintenance, repairs, and upgrades

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds wafer processing systems from sourced components for manufacturers and research labs; service provider: Maintains and upgrades installed equipment for manufacturers and research labs

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, and Asia, including China, Taiwan, South Korea, Japan, and Singapore

specialization.value: related lines: Thin film deposition, etching, laser annealing, lithography, and wet processing equipment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Regional sales teams serving manufacturers and research institutions; agents / brokers: Independent sales representatives in selected markets

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Certain semiconductor equipment exports are subject to U.S. Commerce Department export controls

notes: This describes Veeco on a standalone basis; the closing status of its announced merger with Axcelis is uncertain.
